# ctables/storage

> Where variables live: a local array, C parameters and C globals.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/storage.pkg)

  The compiler renders a section of this package wherever a template asks
  for a variable's `{addr}`, and `decl` once per global.

  | section | for | C |
  |---|---|---|
  | `local` | a local variable | `L[{index}]`: every function declares `W L[]` for its slots |
  | `param` | a parameter | `p{index}`: functions take `W p0, W p1, ...` |
  | `global` | a `global` | `pk_g_{name}` |
  | `decl` | declaring a global | `static W pk_g_{name};` |

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit local`

```nasm
L[{index}]
```

### `emit param`

```nasm
p{index}
```

### `emit global`

```nasm
pk_g_{name}
```

### `emit decl`

```nasm
static W pk_g_{name};
```
